search.messagesAll.description: Search all chats for a word

plans.sql: WITH matches AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT message.rowid AS message_rowid, thread.agent_id, message.created_at, message.ordinal, message.message_id FROM projection_thread_messages message JOIN projection_threads thread ON thread.thread_id = message.thread_id WHERE LOWER(json_extract(message.message_json, '$.text')) LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' AND COALESCE(json_extract(message.message_json, '$.delivery.status'), '') NOT IN ('queued', 'cancelled') AND COALESCE(message.item_type, '') NOT IN ('commentary', 'routine_quiet_answer') AND COALESCE(message.item_type, '') NOT LIKE 'skill-event:%' AND COALESCE(message.item_type, '') NOT LIKE 'routine-event:%' AND COALESCE(message.item_type, '') NOT LIKE 'routine-run-event:%' AND COALESCE(message.item_type, '') NOT LIKE 'hosted-site-event:%' AND COALESCE(message.item_type, '') NOT LIKE 'marketplace-suggestion:%' AND json_extract(message.message_json, '$.routine') IS NULL AND message.thread_id NOT IN (SELECT thread_id FROM projection_channel_contexts) AND message.thread_id NOT IN (SELECT thread_id FROM projection_agent_threads) ) SELECT counted.count, page.agent_id, message.message_json, COALESCE(side.legacy_task_id, side.thread_id) AS task_id FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM matches) counted LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM matches ORDER BY created_at DESC, ordinal DESC, message_id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ? ) page LEFT JOIN projection_thread_messages message ON message.rowid = page.message_rowid LEFT JOIN projection_agent_threads side ON side.thread_id = message.thread_id ORDER BY page.created_at DESC, page.ordinal DESC, page.message_id DESC
